notes: Team-wide settings. No secrets here, ever. Per-PM settings live in ~/.pm-os/profile.json; per-PM secrets in ~/.pm-os/secrets.env.

eow.rule: PM approves the draft; it is sent as a Slack DM from the PM's own account.

goals_sheet.rule: Read live, never cache sheet contents into this repo. Commercial columns are read for on-track math only and never written into context, queue or digests.
